title: Carousel
description: Fiori carousel: items per page by container width, arrows over the content or beside the page indicator, dots or numeric indicator, cyclic navigation, swipe, the SAP keyboard model (ui5-carousel).

usage.summary: Let users browse a sequence of images or other content pages.
useWhen: Let users browse ordered images or content pages with arrows, keyboard navigation or swipe.
Present one item or a deliberate group at a time while preserving the sequence.

avoidWhen.when: Select a thumbnail and inspect an image or video in a dedicated display area.
Represent one person or business entity with a photo, initials or an icon.
